items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I told Mike Osserman that she work for

ctx.x: Yeah. She was there when I got off. She claimed me. I say wow! Ain't this something! Here's someone I've admired for years, has turned out like this. I've got to go for her. Wow! I'm not going to be no Mr. Holiday, I'm still going to maintain myself, you know. My dignity. I'm John Simmons, I mean I'm not as great a bass player as she is a singer, but I still want to be known as John Simmons, the bassist. Not John Simmons, Lady Day's man, you know. So she worked across Onyx the street at the Mike (E) [Osserman]…
